status: COMMITTED BEFORE ANY CURVE IS COMPUTED

why_this_is_committed_first.statement: Both lenses already exist and recomputation is cheap, so 'compute both conventions and keep the one with a band' is trivially available. OD-012 requires that to be blocked by construction rather than by intention.
structural_guarantees: adjudication runs only on external control models
lens_A and lens_B are not read until the convention is committed and its hash recorded
a committed check will prove that every journal record referencing lens_A or lens_B carries a timestamp later than this commit

rung_A1.question: does the official library provide a readout / kurtosis path?
rung_A1.reasoning: A-1 can only end adjudication if it resolves the convention. The library computes no moments anywhere, so adopting its readout path, which EQ1 already used and which the library's own analysis code confirms, leaves the vocabulary-versus-dataset axis question untouched.

V.name: vocabulary axis
V.definition: for a fixed (position, layer), excess kurtosis over the vocabulary dimension of that readout

D.name: dataset axis
D.definition: for a fixed (position, layer), excess kurtosis of the readout logit collected across a large set of activations
D.implementation_frozen_here: for a fixed (position, layer) and a fixed vocabulary entry v, collect the logit for v across N activations, take the excess kurtosis of that N-sample distribution, then average over vocabulary entries and positions. The distribution whose kurtosis is measured therefore runs along the DATASET axis, which is the reading the paper's phrase 'across a large data set of activations' admits and which V does not implement.
D.N_source: the same heldout row count EQ1 used, so the two conventions see identical activations

the_two_candidate_conventions.both_conventions_consume_the_identical_r: jlens apply() raw logits; the conventions differ only in which axis the moment is taken along

rung_A2.rule: adopt the convention that reproduces the externally published band on the positive control AND produces no band on the negative control

how_the_external_band_is_located.source: the official repository's own definitions, recovered in r0/external_method.json
procedure: use the six official lens-eval sets, 551 labelled items, each carrying `intermediates` (ground-truth readable content) and a source-fixed readout position
for each layer, read out with the external lens through the official path and rank the vocabulary
score each item at each layer by the minimum rank over its intermediates, or over the registered synonym set for order-ops
readrate(layer) = fraction of items whose score is <= k
how_the_external_band_is_located.k_justification: k = 1 is not chosen by us. It is the official Hit definition verbatim: 'a target token is a hit if it appears at lens rank 1'.
how_the_external_band_is_located.external_band: the longest contiguous run of layers whose readrate is at least half of the maximum readrate, computed on the positive control
how_the_external_band_is_located.why_half_of_maximum: this is the same shape rule EQ1 used for C2. It is scale-free and contains no absolute threshold, so it cannot be tuned; the quantity it is applied to is externally defined and label-driven.

decision_rule.correct_convention: the one whose kurtosis band on the positive control overlaps the rank-derived external band with the higher Jaccard index, provided it also produces no band on the negative control
decision_rule.discrimination_requirement: the two conventions must give materially different answers; if both match equally, A-2 cannot discriminate and A-3 is used
decision_rule.if_neither_matches: hard blocker 7. Return to R-0. Do NOT proceed to T.

rung_A3.rule: adopt the convention reproducing the paper's published qualitative signature
rung_A3.signature_verbatim: near zero through the first third of the layers, increases beginning around a third of the way through the depth, and falls in the last few layers

operationalisation_frozen_now.L1: mean kurtosis over the first third of layers is the LOWEST of the three thirds
operationalisation_frozen_now.L2: the maximum lies in the middle third
operationalisation_frozen_now.L3: the mean over the final three layers is below the maximum

rung_A3.why_this_cannot_be_tuned_by_us: the signature is a three-landmark description published externally and fixed before any of our numbers existed; the operationalisation above adds no threshold, only the ordering the sentence already states

thresholds_for_R2.source_rule: authority section 6: band criteria and thresholds for R-2 must come from the external method and be calibrated on the positive control, never on T
thresholds_for_R2.criteria_form: EQ1's C1 to C5 unchanged in form: interior maximum, contiguity, coverage, cross-fit agreement, exceeds a matched-norm null

calibration_procedure_frozen_now.C1: unchanged: argmax must not sit on either endpoint of the measured curve
calibration_procedure_frozen_now.C2: unchanged: half-height threshold, longest contiguous run
calibration_procedure_frozen_now.C3_coverage: the required band length is set to the band length the POSITIVE CONTROL exhibits under the winning convention, minus a tolerance of 2 layers, floored at 3. It is NOT EQ1's 7.
calibration_procedure_frozen_now.C4: unchanged: Jaccard >= 0.70 and argmax separation <= 3, applied across EQ1's two independent half-lenses
calibration_procedure_frozen_now.C5_margin: the required margin over the matched-norm null is set to half of the margin the POSITIVE CONTROL exhibits under the winning convention. It is NOT EQ1's 1.0.
calibration_procedure_frozen_now.direction_of_these_changes_is_not_predic: the calibration may make C3 and C5 stricter or looser than EQ1's values; both directions are accepted in advance, and the calibrated numbers are committed before T is touched

explicitly_not_permitted: adjusting a threshold after seeing T's curve
reusing EQ1's 7-layer and 1.0-margin values as if they had been externally derived
thresholds_for_R2.eq1_thresholds_are_not_being_relaxed: EQ1's Q-4a verdict stands under EQ1's own frozen numbers and is not recomputed. The calibrated numbers here govern a DIFFERENT question asked under a different, externally validated convention.

negative_control_stop.rule: if gpt2-small shows a band under the selected convention, the convention is not discriminative
negative_control_stop.consequence: adjudication fails, terminal state STUDY5_EQ2_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_CONTAMINATED, do not proceed to T
negative_control_stop.not_a_licence_to_switch: failing here does NOT permit picking the other convention on the basis of T's result

what_would_falsify_the_whole_exercise.statement: If neither V nor D reproduces the external band on the positive control, then our readout path has a deeper defect and nothing about T may be inferred or measured.
what_would_falsify_the_whole_exercise.the_positive_control_is_the_load_bearing: it is the same architecture, same scale family, same corpus and same library as T, fitted by an independent party

claim_ceiling: This is an adjudication rule. It licenses no claim of any kind, and no result it can produce is a scientific finding.
